text: 2c.1-B2 TAMAM: EventGvG tam uygulama — donor 1138 satir birebir port (EventGvG.cpp 137→905; tek sapma donor gettype→GetAsNumber yazim hatasi + load guard: dosya yoksa BLANK, ExitProcess korumasi). Canli kanit denetimi: canli map tekrar tarandi — CGvGEvent sinif sembolleri canlida YOK (motor canli exe'de derli degil, sadece 7 config anahtari); donor canlisinda da EventGvGEvent.dat deploy edilmemis + /startgvg komut satiri yok → kapali modul; bizde inert GvGEvent.dat x3 deploy (Switch=0, bos zaman tablosu → CheckSync BLANK kilidi; etkinlestirme Switch=1 + zaman satiri). 9 kanca donor wiring birebir: ServerInfo Load, MonsterManager Init, NpcTalk Dialog, Attack CheckPlayerTarget/StandTarget/PlayerJoined/SelfTeam, ObjectManager respawn, User UserDieProc, GameServer IDM_STARTGVG(121), CommandManager COMMAND_STARTGVG=86 (pozisyonel baglama korundu, renumber yok) + CommandStartGvG. Derleme temiz → 10.816.512 B (21:42, +7168); exe kanit: GvGEvent.dat/CommandStartGvG/Set GVG Start stringleri. Sirada: B tekil event'leri (B3 ActiveInvasions) veya A2 MonsterSkill.
